text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A'ight, everybody! Pull that shrine with
all your
might!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And a one, two, hup!

text_block_list.name: Mikoshi Carriers
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh boy. It really won't budge, huh. Well
this isn't
going to plan...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Fleetfoot Festival,
and
Tamamo Cross and Inari One are
leading the
mikoshi shrine procession.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's a lot heavier than I thought.
It feels
like we're
trying to move a tank.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You know what, Ardan, don't even worry
about it.
All we need is...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Some elbow grease!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now hang on, Inari. All the elbow grease
in the
world isn't gonna help unless
we're all on the same
page.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's movin' out of sync. What we
really
need is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
To talk to 'em one by one. Just like you
do with
little ones.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey Ardan, what's up? What's gotcha
troubled?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... I was just assessing the
situation, and I
realized that I really
need to synchronize with
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're overthinkin' it.
If ya try and adapt
to
everyone else, you'll always be one
step behind.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Just go with whatever feels natural!
Don't worry,
it'll all come together.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo, I have the opposite problem. I
always
end up going too fast for
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah right, you do martial arts, don'cha?
You're
probably focusin' too hard!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to move like a lightnin'
bolt or
anythin'! Just take it easy and
pause a bit after
each step.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama, as for me...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: As for you...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'll get ya somethin' to eat once we're
done!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: All right! I think I've got this.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Okay, we've got it this time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And a one, two, hup!

text_block_list.name: Mikoshi Carriers
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wow, way to go, Tama! Just goes to
show what
we're capable of when push
comes to shove!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, see? Told ya. They just needed a
little
helpin' hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Tamamo's thoughtful
leadership, the
team unite and lift the
shrine with ease.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer, how d'ya think we should
carry this shrine around? Should we take
it easy or have fun
and get rowdy with
it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It is a special occasion. The best way to
get the
audience excited would be to...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Rope in the kids, eh? Good idea. I bet
they'd love
that!
choice_data_list: Having fun together with the kids

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right, kiddos! Gather round! We're
gonna show
ya how to carry the festival
shrine!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's it, good job. Now tense up your
belly a bit
more.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It's all about your breath. Imagine you're

becoming one with the mikoshi.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Um, grab onto the shrine, not my hair,
okay?
Let's stay focused, now.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's like you're at one with the
gods! Nice
work, guys!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you were right, Trainer. This is the
best way
to get everyone together,
havin' fun!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I should take a pic for the kiddos back in
Osaka.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Inari.
Bring all the little ones 'round
here!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Click!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through her calm interaction with the
children, Tamamo Cross learns that
there's more to
festivals than making a
loud spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a mikoshi battle could be fun! Not
bad,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right, everyone! Let's see which team
is the
strongest and fastest at carryin'
the shrine!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right! Sounds like a plan!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You've changed your tune, though,
Tama. Just a second ago, you were a
gentle teacher, and now
you're all fired
up.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Course. I had to be calm and explain
things first
so we could get together and
win the battle!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm 'bout to show ya some Naniwa guts!
Everyone
pull the floooat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's... not a float. But that doesn't stop
Tamamo
Cross from going wild and
having a blast at the
fall festival.
